# One case per line, assembled as a file of its own; `;` separates the
# statements of a case. See run.sh.
#
# ---- nothing but code ----
nop
ret
pushq %rbp;movq %rsp, %rbp;popq %rbp;retq
# ---- branches ----
callq _ext
jmp _ext
je _ext
jne _ext
callq _ext+4
callq _ext-4
jmp _ext+100
callq *_ext(%rip)
jmp *_ext(%rip)
callq _f;_f: ret
jmp _f;_f: ret
je _f;_f: ret
callq Lf;Lf: ret
jmp Lf;Lf: ret
je Lf;Lf: ret
_f: callq _f
_f: jmp _f
_f: callq Lf;Lf: ret
_f: jmp Lf;Lf: ret
_f: callq _g;_g: ret
_f: jmp _g;_g: ret
_f: je _g;_g: ret
_f: nop;Lb: nop;_g: callq Lb
_f: nop;Lb: nop;_g: jmp Lb
.globl _f;_f: callq _f
.globl _g;_f: callq _g;_g: ret
.private_extern _g;_f: callq _g;_g: ret
callq _f+2;_f: nop;nop;ret
# ---- RIP-relative, with the bytes after the displacement ----
leaq _ext(%rip), %rax
leaq _ext+8(%rip), %rax
leaq _ext-8(%rip), %rax
movq _ext(%rip), %rax
movl _ext(%rip), %eax
movw _ext(%rip), %ax
movb _ext(%rip), %al
movq %rax, _ext(%rip)
movb $1, _ext(%rip)
movw $1, _ext(%rip)
movl $1, _ext(%rip)
movq $1, _ext(%rip)
cmpl $1, _ext(%rip)
cmpq $0x12345, _ext(%rip)
addb $1, _ext+3(%rip)
testb $1, _ext(%rip)
cmpps $3, _ext(%rip), %xmm1
vcmpps $3, _ext(%rip), %ymm1, %ymm2
vpternlogd $0xff, _ext(%rip), %zmm1, %zmm2
pinsrw $1, _ext(%rip), %xmm0
imull $3, _ext(%rip), %eax
imulw $0x1234, _ext(%rip), %ax
leaq _f(%rip), %rax;_f: ret
_f: leaq _f(%rip), %rax
_f: leaq Lf(%rip), %rax;Lf: ret
_f: leaq _g(%rip), %rax;_g: ret
_f: movb $1, Lf(%rip);Lf: ret
Lf: leaq Lf(%rip), %rax
Lf: movl $1, Lf(%rip)
# ---- through the GOT ----
movq _ext@GOTPCREL(%rip), %rax
movq _ext@GOTPCREL(%rip), %r12
movl _ext@GOTPCREL(%rip), %eax
leaq _ext@GOTPCREL(%rip), %rax
addq _ext@GOTPCREL(%rip), %rax
pushq _ext@GOTPCREL(%rip)
callq *_ext@GOTPCREL(%rip)
jmp *_ext@GOTPCREL(%rip)
movq _ext@GOTPCREL+4(%rip), %rax
cmpq $1, _ext@GOTPCREL(%rip)
callq _ext@GOTPCREL
_f: movq _f@GOTPCREL(%rip), %rax
movq Lf@GOTPCREL(%rip), %rax;Lf: ret
# ---- absolute references ----
movl $_ext, %eax
movl $_ext+4, %eax
movabsq $_ext, %rax
movabsq $_ext+16, %rax
movq $_ext, %rax
pushq $_ext
movl _ext, %eax
movq _ext(,%rax,8), %rcx
leal _ext, %eax
movl $_f, %eax;_f: ret
movabsq $_f, %rax;_f: ret
movabsq $Lf, %rax;Lf: ret
_f: movabsq $Lf, %rax;Lf: ret
addl $(_g - _f), %ebx;_f: nop;_g: nop
_f: nop;_g: nop;addl $(_g - _f), %ebx
Lf: nop;Lg: nop;addl $(Lg - Lf), %ebx
_f: nop;Lg: nop;addl $(Lg - _f), %ebx
Lf: nop;_g: nop;addl $(_g - Lf), %ebx
_f: nop;_g: nop;movl $(_g - _f), %eax
# ---- data ----
.quad _ext
.long _ext
.quad _ext+8
.quad _ext-8
.long _ext+1
.short _ext
.byte _ext
.quad _f;_f: ret
.long _f;_f: ret
.quad Lf;Lf: ret
.quad Lf+3;Lf: ret
_f: .quad Lf;Lf: ret
.quad _f - _g;_f: ret;_g: ret
.long _f - _g;_f: ret;_g: ret
.quad _g - _f;_f: ret;_g: ret
_f: ret;_g: ret;.long _g - _f
_f: ret;_g: ret;.quad _g - _f + 5
_f: jmp _ext;_g: ret;.long _g - _f
.long _f - .;_f: ret
.long . - _f;_f: ret
_f: ret;.long _f - .
.long Lf - .;Lf: ret
.long _ext - .
.long _ext - _f;_f: ret
.long _ext@GOTPCREL
.long _ext@GOTPCREL+4
.long _ext@GOTPCREL-.
.quad _ext@GOTPCREL
# ---- sections ----
.data;.quad 1
.data;_d: .quad _d
.data;.quad Ld;Ld: .quad 0
.data;_d: .quad 0;.text;movq _d(%rip), %rax
.data;Ld: .quad 0;.text;movq Ld(%rip), %rax
.data;Ld: .quad 0;.text;movl $1, Ld(%rip)
.data;Ld: .quad 0;.text;_f: movq Ld(%rip), %rax
.const;_c: .quad 1;.text;leaq _c(%rip), %rax
.cstring;Ls: .asciz "hi";.text;leaq Ls(%rip), %rdi
.cstring;Ls: .asciz "hi";.text;leaq Ls+1(%rip), %rdi
.cstring;Ls: .asciz "hi";.text;movb $0, Ls(%rip)
.cstring;.asciz "a";Ls: .asciz "hi";.data;.quad Ls
.cstring;.asciz "a";Ls: .asciz "hi";.data;.quad Ls+1
.literal4;L4: .long 0x3f800000;.text;movss L4(%rip), %xmm0
.literal8;L8: .quad 0x3ff0000000000000;.text;movsd L8(%rip), %xmm0
.literal16;.quad 1, 2
.bss;.space 8
.bss;_b: .space 8;.text;movq _b(%rip), %rax
.section __TEXT,__foo;.byte 1
.section __DATA,__foo;.quad _ext
.section __TEXT,__textcoal_nt,coalesced,pure_instructions;ret
.section __DATA,__mod_init_func,mod_init_funcs;.quad _f;.text;_f: ret
.mod_init_func;.quad _ext
.mod_term_func;.quad _ext
.non_lazy_symbol_pointer;.quad 0
.lazy_symbol_pointer;.quad 0
.tdata;.quad 1
.tlv;.quad 0
.const_data;.quad _ext
.static_const;.byte 1
.static_data;.byte 1
.constructor;.byte 1
.destructor;.byte 1
.section __TEXT,__text;ret
.section __TEXT,__cstring,cstring_literals;.asciz "x"
.section __DATA,__data,regular,no_dead_strip;.byte 1
.section __TEXT,__stub,symbol_stubs,pure_instructions,6;ret
.section __DATA,__zz,zerofill;.space 4
.rodata;.byte 1
# ---- alignment ----
.align 3;ret
.p2align 4;ret
.balign 16;ret
nop;.align 3;ret
nop;.p2align 4, 0x90;ret
.data;.byte 1;.align 3;.byte 2
.data;.byte 1;.p2align 2;.byte 2
# ---- symbols ----
.globl _g;_g: ret
.globl _z, _a;_z: ret;_a: ret
.private_extern _p;_p: ret
.weak_definition _w;_w: ret
.globl _w;.weak_definition _w;_w: ret
.weak_reference _u;callq _u
.weak_reference _u
.alt_entry _a;_f: nop;_a: ret
.no_dead_strip _f;_f: ret
.globl _u;callq _u
.comm _c, 8, 3
.comm _c, 16
.lcomm _l, 8, 3
.lcomm _l, 8
.zerofill __DATA,__common,_z,16,4
.zerofill __DATA,__bss,_z,8
_a = 5
.globl _a;_a = 5
_f: ret;_a = _f
_f: ret;_a = _f + 1;.globl _a
.set _a, 0x1234
_Lnot_temp: ret
lfoo: ret
Lfoo: ret
.subsections_via_symbols
.subsections_via_symbols;_f: callq _g;_g: ret
